title: USDA Departmental Manual Extraction Schema
description: Schema for extracting broadly useful structured data from a USDA departmental manual concerning legislative reports and proposals.

document_type.description: Type of document, such as Departmental Manual.

office_of_primary_interest.description: Office of Primary Interest (OPI) listed in the document.

publication_date.description: Document issue or publication date as written in the document.

expiration_date.description: Document expiration date as written in the document.

scope.description: Statement describing who or what the document applies to.

background.description: Background information explaining the context for the document.

policy.description: Policy statements, obligations, or directives stated in the document.

policy_id.description: Identifier or letter/number for the policy item, if present.

policy_text.description: Text of the policy statement, obligation, or directive.

policy_actor_01.description: Primary actor responsible for or subject to the policy obligation.

policy_actor_02.description: Second actor responsible for or subject to the policy obligation, if applicable.

policy_actor_03.description: Third actor responsible for or subject to the policy obligation, if applicable.

policy_actor_04.description: Fourth actor responsible for or subject to the policy obligation, if applicable.

sections.description: Top-level sections listed in the document.

section_title.description: Title of the section or appendix.

page_reference.description: Page number or page reference shown in the table of contents, if available.

contacts.description: Contact points or inquiry channels provided in the document.

contact_type.description: Type of contact, such as email or office.

contact_value.description: Actual contact information, such as an email address.

context.description: Context describing when or why this contact is used.

acronyms.description: Acronyms and abbreviations defined in the document.

definitions.description: Defined terms and their definitions from the document.

source.description: Source cited for the definition, if provided.

authorities_and_references.description: Authorities and references cited in the document.

citation.description: Citation or title of the authority/reference.

description.description: Explanation of the authority or reference, if provided.
